answers.stem_only: The application keeps state in files on its EBS volume and cannot run as several copies, so horizontal scaling (Auto Scaling group, load balancer) is ruled out. Scale vertically: stop the instance, change it to a larger instance type with more vCPUs and memory, and start it again. EBS-backed instances keep their root and data volumes across a stop and start, and the instance type cannot be changed while the instance is running, so a short planned stop is the minimal downtime.
